title: THE SEAL OPENS MARGINALLY QUICKER
why: His note of 2026-10-03, given mid-raid: the seal should open marginally quicker. The cut needed 40 seconds at stage 1, 65 at stage 2 and 90 at stage 3; it is 34, 55 and 76 now, about fifteen percent less at every stage. Progress already banked carries over as it was.
now: The seal opens about fifteen percent quicker at every stage.

edits.replacement: function sealNeed(tier){ return 34+tier*21; }   // v16.xx: his note of 2026-10-03, marginally quicker (was 40+tier*25)
